decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The application for the erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house, as shown on drawings  numbered 03-01-02 and 03-01-05, received 4th October 2006, is acceptable by reason of its size, position and appearance that would not be detrimental to the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. The development is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - Informative: If the proposed new rear extension (reference: 00169/22/P1, P/2006/3109) is built prior to the roof extensions proposed in the concurrent application for a Certificate of Lawfulness would no longer be permitted development and planning permission would be required.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to the existing house
